scope: Rules evident in source, contract, and existing Cucumber scenarios; test expectations are explicitly distinguished from implemented server guarantees.

workflows.name: Mock person lookup and transfer
steps: User enters one or more supported criteria in the Vue form.
Search scans a local embedded sample set and includes a record if any supplied criterion matches.
User selects a person and one of its associated payment-recipient entries.
Transfer sends the person record with the chosen recipient as a target=textfield WebSocket envelope.
Node relay broadcasts the message to every connected client; the alternate Swing client maps person and payment fields into its controls.
rules: Name, city, street, and house number are case-insensitive substring matches; ZIP is exact equality.
Criteria combine with OR semantics, not AND.
The lookup dataset is static in the component; there is no service-side lookup.
No matching record is selected automatically and no empty-selection validation is implemented.
The selected payment-recipient replaces the recipient list in the outgoing copied record.
Relay broadcasts received UTF-8 payloads to all connected peers, including sender; no message validation or persistence occurs.

workflows.name: Notes synchronization
steps: A watcher sends target=textarea and the text value.
Swing client replaces its notes area when the target is textarea.
rules: Each notes change is sent; the client does not debounce in the observed source.
The receiving textarea is replaced, not appended.
No authorization, delivery acknowledgment, or offline queue is present.

workflows.name: Swing form submission
steps: Presenter mirrors text and gender selections into typed field wrappers.
Model serializes all enum fields as strings and POSTs JSON to localhost:8080/post.
Non-empty response body is emitted to listeners; empty response emits Failed operation.
Presenter displays response and clears most person and payment controls, selecting female.
rules: All enumerated fields are included regardless of population.
There is no required-field, date, IBAN, BIC, or gender consistency validation in the Java submission path.
Null field values can fail when converted using toString before HTTP request creation.
Successful status code is not evaluated as a business decision; response body emptiness determines emitted success/failure text.
After a response event the textarea is not cleared, and model values are not reset along with UI controls.
Gender choices are mutually exclusive in the Swing view; female starts selected.

workflows.name: API test contract
steps: Cucumber scenario prepares complete, partial, or empty JSON data.
Assertions check status, submitted/updated values, or response content type.
rules: Test scenarios expect HTTP 200 for complete, partial, and empty-object requests.
Complete scenarios exercise gender flag combinations for female, male, and diverse sample users.
Update scenarios expect revised name, address, and banking fields to be reflected in the response.
The contract defines request body as required but does not mark individual properties required; this is distinct from the test of an empty JSON object.
These are test and contract expectations, not evidence of persistence or actual validation rules in the application.

validation_observations: No source-level domain validation was found in the reviewed application paths.
Vue mock search filters with OR semantics and local static fixture data.
Cucumber coverage includes empty and minimal payload behavior but does not test malformed JSON, invalid field formats, nulls in the Swing model, authorization, or persistence.
API model fields are documented as strings, including flags and dates; the contract does not specify formats or constraints.
